Commonly used for broadband filtering of DC power lines, they are often produced in mechanical form factors designed to be mounted within a conductive enclosure, in context of RF, microwave, and other sensitive applications.

Description.DetailedDescription: 0.47 µF Feed Through Capacitor 16V 1 A 0805 (2012 Metric), 4 PC Pad

Category.Name: Filters
Category.SeoDescription: The filter product category includes a wide variety of devices and materials used for the separation, suppression, or selection of electrical and magnetic signals on the basis of frequency. Products designed for use across a wide range of contexts are included, ranging from power lines carrying kiloamperes at DC to radio receivers detecting microvolt-level signals at frequencies of tens of gigahertz.
